text:
ada (Marketing): Drafting a compact "Brightline Brief" one-pager for enterprise secure inference. Goal: 1-page exec summary, 1 benchmark callout slide, short webinar (35m), and inbound routing JSON we can hand to infra. Need quick review.

jorge (Solutions): Nice. Callout requests: explicit fallback strategy (model-variant + region fallback), and a line about certs/KMS integrations.

rita (Field): Bench numbers proposal: test = steady 150 concurrent connections, seq=384, model=redwood-s-quant. Results to show: Hosted p50=140ms p99=410ms, Dedicated p50=40ms p99=75ms, throughput=140 req/s per GPU. Add note that quantization reduces memory but can slightly change quality.

noah (Sales): For inbound routing: tag leads with {segment:enterprise, interest:private, compliance:requires-audit}. Route enterprise+private to AE-enterprise; if requires-audit then add escalation to compliance-specialist. Also capture "expected peak requests/min" on form.

rita (Field): Routing JSON for infra team: 
```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"match": "tags.segment == 'enterprise' && tags.interest == 'private'", "route_to": "queue.AE-enterprise", "priority": 80},
    {"match": "tags.compliance == 'requires-audit'", "route_to": "queue.compliance-specialist", "priority": 95},
    {"fallback": "queue.general-inbound"}
  ]
}
```

jorge (Solutions): SLA blurb suggestion: "SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs published per deployment and model family; customers can request custom SLOs as part of onboarding." Add: "Certificate + KMS integrations available for Private deployments."

ada (Marketing): (note: typo in name fixed) I'll use Jorge's SLA wording. Webinar outline: 35m total -> 6m market framing, 12m demo (deploy modes + console walkthrough), 12m benchmarks & measurement methodology, 5m live Q&A + CTAs (private trial link). Noah will moderate Q&A.

ops-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/brightline/onepager-v1.pdf and /assets/brightline/webinar-landing.html. Reminder: schedule tentative Wed 11am PT.

rita (Field): Customer blurb for slide 1 (two lines): "DataSecure ran a 3-week pilot in Private VPC with Redwood and cut inference cost by ~2.5x while achieving 99.95% uptime. Pilot used dedicated GPUs + full audit logging."

noah (Sales): Landing copy first pass: "Secure inference without tradeoffs. Join our Brightline Brief webinar to see how teams meet enterprise SLAs, lower runtime costs, and run in VPCs or on-prem. Includes live demo + customer pilot story." Adding FAQ and registration questions now.

ada (Marketing): Two quick asks before I finalize v1: (1) @rita confirm the exact DataSecure phrasing OK to publish, (2) @jorge confirm KMS/certs line. Will publish the one-pager + launch post once both confirm. Thanks! :sparkles:
